errors.evidence: The legend in the figure maps Франция to orange, Китай/континентален to gray, Италия to yellow, Турция to light blue, САЩ to green, matching the description; however the machine text swaps the colors for Франция and Китай/континентален with the reference/image order, and also assigns light blue to Турция and green to САЩ correctly? No actual mapping error here.
